Well, that's certainly a request! Freud and humor don't always go hand-in-hand, but I admire your creativity. Essentially, the "death drive"—or *Thanatos*—is Freud's idea that we all have an innate drive toward a return to an inorganic state, a kind of cosmic rest. 

Think of it as the opposite of the life drive, *Eros*. As for your comedian example... perhaps a weary sigh and a muttered, "Must I? Really?"
